name: Women And Men
overview: Scripture reveals a complementary and unified relationship between women and men within the body of Christ. Women such as Priscilla and Phebe actively serve and teach in the church, with examples of prophetic ministry and instruction demonstrating their vital roles. At the same time, Galatians 3:28 affirms that in Christ there is no distinction between male and female, emphasizing spiritual equality and unity. The instruction for older women to teach good things in Titus 2:3 further highlights the godly responsibilities entrusted to women in the church community.
